rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a room where people sleep.

example.english: This bedroom faces south, so it's bright in the morning.
example.traditional: 呢間睡房向南，朝早好光猛。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 seoi6 fong4 hoeng3 naam4 ziu1 zou2 hou2 gwong1 maang5

rows.note: Use this euphemistic phrase when “bedroom” refers to a couple’s sex life rather than the physical room.

example.english: After they moved, their bedroom life became more active.
example.traditional: 佢哋搬咗屋之後，床上生活都豐富咗。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bun1 zo2 uk1 zi1 hau6 cong4 soeng6 sang1 wut6 dou1 fung1 fu3 zo2
